items.statement: The validated comparison supports a relative stability difference between the two C1-attacked model intermediates, within the submitted method and model boundary.
items.expected: syn_syn is lower in solution-phase Gibbs free energy than syn_anti by about 2.3 kcal/mol; the conclusion is qualified by method and model limitations.

items.statement: The geometry comparison identifies greater angular distortion in the higher-energy state and explains the interpretation boundary.
items.expected: syn_anti has the wider C2-C3-C4 angle; this is consistent with the paper's distortion interpretation but does not by itself prove the entire catalytic mechanism.
